cards.name: Dream Clown
cards.effect: If this Attack Position card is changed to face-up Defense Position: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

cards.name: Crass Clown
cards.effect: If this Defense Position card is changed to Attack Position: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

behavior: Dream Clown only accepts face-up Attack to face-up Defense transitions.
Crass Clown accepts Defense to face-up Attack transitions, including a face-down Defense Flip Summon.
The source may leave the field after the recorded position change and remain eligible from its physical owner's Graveyard.
Target selection is restricted to the opposing team and current monster-effect immunity; face-down monsters remain valid targets.
A target binding prevents substitution if the selected monster leaves the field, changes identity, or changes to the controller's team.
Dream Clown destruction routes to the target's physical owner's Graveyard.
Crass Clown returns a non-Fusion monster to its physical owner's hand, a Fusion monster to that owner's Extra Deck, and removes a Token without inventing inventory.
Inactive owners receive returned cards in their own reserve hand/Extra Deck.
A hand that grows above six is left untouched; the existing End Phase flow owns discard.
implementation.integrationBoundary: Isolated TagDuel adapter only. No catalog registration, central resolver, command handler, or Discord runtime integration was changed.

focusedScenarios: Dream Clown destroys a face-down target and respects the target's physical owner under stolen control
Crass Clown returns a card to an inactive physical owner's reserve hand
Crass Clown routes a Fusion monster to the owner's Extra Deck
source leaves field after the position-change event
selected target leaves field and cannot be replaced
selected target changes to the controller's team
negation and duplicate activation are idempotent
3+3 zones, Main Deck 20/30, Extra Deck maximum five

limitations: The production adapter is pinned to the official passcodes but these cards are not registered in the catalog/resolver on this branch.
The host must provide a genuine position-change event, controller-at-activation team, and whether the source left the field after the event.
Central trigger integration and Discord command validation remain separate work.
